scope: Source-only conditional callback timing qualification against explicitly declared Android15/Chromium126 public source. Not the installed provider, actual callback trace, transport classification or acceptance.

actual.sample_boundary: Last bounded in-wait sample, not every instant of callback dispatch
actual.originals_owned_by: storage_rebase_finish; reviewer read only immutable-source and public-safe derivatives

safe_derivative_suite_time_addendum.communication_scope: Storage reconciled from its already-owned original, not independently reread here

source_findings.observation: onPageStarted documents main-frame scope and fragment/frame exclusions; no before-response-headers timing promise. onPageCommitVisible separately describes response body reflected in DOM.
source_findings.limit: Does not prove actual provider behavior or equate onPageStarted with onPageCommitVisible.

source_findings.observation: Declared Chromium126 returns page-start-on-commit true for all renderer initiation and for browser initiation except com.google.android.gms below version15000000. The alternative delegate posts an earlier start only if that flag is false. Normal non-same-document/non-error-page observer posts start after navigation.hasCommitted.
source_findings.limit: Runtime context/package/provider version and flag value not observed; other unacquired native/glue paths are not universal timing proof.

source_findings.observation: For a genuine main-frame non-error-URL non-abort error, when commit flag is enabled the bridge posts start, then the received-error callback, then finish. Abort notifications are suppressed (comment explicitly includes WebView.stopLoading).
source_findings.limit: Source textual queue order only; zero-byte EOF -> specific NetError and actual delivery/classification are unproved. Proposal still requires actual matching native main-frame error and finish; no error code is invented.

source_findings.observation: Actual WebView public stop calls WebContents.stop. Main-frame ERR_ABORTED processing posts finish without posting start, even before the uncommitted navigation returns. HTTP error-page response-code failure is a distinct start+finish path.
source_findings.limit: Not actual Stop evidence. Stop was not invoked in actual41282126027; exact failingURL/peer EOF/finish must be genuinely observed in a new request.

source_findings.observation: Frozen fixture withholds every response byte until recorded start, before a zero-byte refusal, Stop, actual302 and destination/Reload document. That prerequisite can be incompatible with the expressly commit-gated baseline and is not a literal original #64 deadline.
source_findings.limit: This supports an owning prerequisite repair, not diagnosis of why the installed provider recorded no start.

source_findings.observation: Production real start resets request state through beginRequest under the same current-owner gate; real finish/errors update common state. Public LoadUrl runs real acceptContent, while the native fail/fail fixture bypasses it. Public Reload and Stop call native APIs.
source_findings.limit: Production bytes unchanged by proposal; public accepted Stop state is not substituted for the native fail/fail reset witness.

proposal_qualification.held_request: Wait only for the exact acquired lease, current observed stage and same real native owner; require still-zero bytes/unreleased counters before releasing actual refusal/response. Keep all original wait/hold deadlines.
proposal_qualification.reset: Both probes record and immediately assert resets only after super.onPageStarted from the real matching current-owner callback; existing normal/error terminal assertStarts stays. No beginRequest or synthetic callback is called by the test.
proposal_qualification.stop: Only real matching onPageFinished after stopInvoked may record the already-zero generation for WaitForStop. The finished predicate keeps stage/current-owner guards and same-generation real finish. All other terminal paths retain positive genuine start generation. Existing public Stop, peer EOF, zero response/release/cleanup and common Finished/title/URL/error assertions remain.
proposal_qualification.redirect_reload: Release actual302 from the owned redirect lease, then exact landing lease/document; later genuine destination start/finish/DOM/finalURL remain required. Reload stays public and requires actual current native URL, unchanged declarative content, no-store different DOM and unchanged redirect request count.
proposal_qualification.unverified: One-file private candidate only; no compiler/model/test/native execution or live edits. Parent owns owning guard integration, frozen compile/request, original source/results review and acceptance.
